edl:
*** Begin EDL
*** Trim Clip
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=hook-rough
+ start: 3.0
+ end: 8.0
*** Delete Clip
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=host-reset
*** Set Audio Lead
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=guest-proof
+ lead_s: 0.42
+ reason: let the guest proof begin under the end of the hook instead of adding a visible transition
+ confidence: 0.87
*** Set Cut Intent
@@ between: clip_uuid=hook-rough and clip_uuid=guest-proof
+ cut_type: j_cut
+ intent: short_form_speaker_handoff
+ audio_relation: audio_leads
+ confidence: 0.87
+ reason: rough assembly cleanup keeps pace by leading the guest proof under the hook
*** Set Cut Intent
@@ between: clip_uuid=guest-proof and clip_uuid=product-insert
+ cut_type: insert
+ intent: visual_evidence_cover
+ confidence: 0.83
+ reason: product insert covers the explanation without implying a new scene
*** Set Output Format
+ aspect_ratio: 9:16
+ platform: youtube_shorts
+ safe_area: mobile
*** Set Package Metadata
+ platform: youtube_shorts
+ title: Edit the pause before the answer
+ description: Short-form rough assembly cleanup with a J-cut and product insert.
+ tags: editing,j-cut,shorts
*** End EDL
